plugins.description:
Privacy policy generator and terms and conditions generator for WordPress. Publish your legal pages in one click.

WPLP Legal Pages is a legal page generator for GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy laws. Answer a short questionnaire about what your site does. The plugin writes your privacy policy, terms and conditions, cookie policy, disclaimer, and 30+ other legal pages, then publishes them as normal WordPress pages on your domain.

  • ✅ Free: Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, DMCA Notice, and CCPA Privacy Notice
  • ✅ One click from questionnaire to a live page
  • ✅ Priced by site count, never per document. See plans
  • ✅ One login for every client site, with the WPLP web app

3-minute setup walkthrough. Try it first in the Live Preview.

⚡ How it works

  1. Add your business details once. Business name, address, domain, niche. Every page you generate uses them.
  2. Answer the questionnaire. Tell it what your site collects: contact forms, analytics, newsletter sign-ups, checkout, affiliate links.
  3. Publish. The page goes live on your domain. Edit it in Gutenberg, Elementor, or Divi, the same as any other page.

📄 Legal pages you can generate

Who writes them? Every template is written and reviewed by the WPLP in-house legal team and professionals. Templates come in 7 languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, and Portuguese.

Free, in this plugin

  • Privacy Policy
  • Terms of Use
  • DMCA Notice
  • CCPA (California) Privacy Notice

30+ legal page templates on WPLP paid plans

  • Privacy policy templates: Professional Privacy Policy (GDPR and CCPA), GDPR Privacy Policy, CPRA, Professional CCPA, COPPA
  • Cookie policy templates: GDPR Cookie Policy, Cookies Policy, Double Dart Cookies
  • Terms and conditions templates: Terms and Conditions (terms of service), Terms with forced agreement, End User License Agreement (EULA), Affiliate Agreement
  • Ecommerce: Returns & Refunds Policy, Digital Goods Refund Policy
  • Disclaimers: General Disclaimer, Earnings Disclaimer, Medical Disclaimer
  • Disclosures: Affiliate Disclosure, Amazon Affiliate Disclosure, FTC Statement, Advertising Disclosure, Testimonials Disclosure, Confidentiality Disclosure
  • EU: Impressum, EU Declaration of Conformity, Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure (CVD) Policy for the Cyber Resilience Act
  • Other: About Us, Blog Comments Policy, Linking Policy, External Links Policy, Facebook Policy, Newsletter Subscription & Disclaimer, Antispam, Custom Legal Page

🏢 Built for agencies and multiple client sites

Every client site needs a privacy policy and terms page, and each one collects different data. Copying one client’s policy onto the next site doesn’t hold up.

Manage every client site’s legal pages from one login. WPLP Legal Pages connects to the WPLP web app (app.wplegalpages.com). The web app is included on every plan, Free included.

  • Multi-site management: add each client site, apply templates, and see which sites have which pages in one list.
  • No WordPress Multisite needed: each client site keeps its own install and its own database.
  • Your branding on client sites: remove WPLP branding and add your own logo (paid plans).
  • Policy updates across the roster: when a law changes, WPLP drafts the new text. Nothing publishes until you approve it (paid plans).
  • One vendor for pages and banner: manage WPLP Cookie Consent from the same login.

Same features on every paid plan

Professional, Business, and Agency have every feature. The price changes only with the number of sites:

  • Free: 1 site
  • Professional: up to 3 sites
  • Business: up to 10 sites
  • Agency: 25, 50, or 100 sites

A 3-site freelancer and a 100-site agency get the same templates and tools. See the pricing page.

🔄 How your pages stay current

Laws change. A privacy policy written 2 years ago may not match what the law asks for today.

  • Edit at any time. Every page is a normal WordPress page.
  • Tell returning visitors. The free policy update banner shows that a page changed, and the date it changed.
  • Auto-updates on law change (paid plans). When a relevant law changes, WPLP drafts updated text for your page. A notice in your dashboard tells you it’s ready. Nothing goes live until you review and approve it.

🧰 Features

Free

  • Guided 4-step page wizard with a business profile that fills every page
  • Automatic legal page links in the site footer
  • Policy update banner for returning visitors, with the date of the change
  • Affiliate disclosure notice, added with one toggle
  • Adult site content declaration
  • Control whether search engines index your legal pages
  • WPLP block for Gutenberg
  • Shortcode for every legal page

Every paid plan (Professional, Business, and Agency)

Same features on every plan. Compare plans and prices.

  • 30+ legal page templates
  • Legal pages in a popup, with an accept button
  • Forced agreement: visitors accept selected terms before they continue, including at WooCommerce checkout
  • Age verification popup for 18+ content and age-restricted products, with custom wording and page rules
  • Auto-updates on law change, with your approval before anything goes live
  • Remove WPLP branding and add your own logo

⭐ Why WPLP Legal Pages

  • Pages live on your domain. They are standard WordPress pages in your own database.
  • Pages stay if you deactivate. Deactivating removes the generator. Your published pages stay live.
  • No per-document or pageview fees. The 4 free templates have no usage limit.
  • Built for the WordPress editor. Works with Gutenberg, Elementor, and Divi.
  • Part of the WPLP Compliance Platform. Legal pages, cookie consent, and the web app come from one team.

⚖️ Privacy laws covered

  • GDPR (EU): GDPR Privacy Policy, GDPR Cookie Policy, and Professional Privacy Policy templates
  • CCPA and CPRA (California): Standard CCPA (free), Professional CCPA, and CPRA templates
  • COPPA (US): COPPA template for sites that collect data from children under 13
  • EU Cyber Resilience Act: CVD Policy and EU Declaration of Conformity templates
  • Germany, Austria, Switzerland: Impressum template

For cookie consent under LGPD (Brazil) and PIPEDA (Canada), use WPLP Cookie Consent. It covers LGPD on the free plan and PIPEDA on paid plans.

Note: WPLP Legal Pages helps you publish legal pages that match your site. It doesn’t give legal advice. For some situations you still need a lawyer to review your pages. A review costs much less than a lawyer drafting every page from scratch.

👥 Who uses WPLP Legal Pages

  • Agencies and freelancers: legal pages on every client build, managed from one login
  • Bloggers and creators: privacy policy, disclaimer, and the affiliate disclosures ad and affiliate networks ask for
  • WooCommerce stores: refund, returns, privacy, and terms pages that payment processors ask for
  • Business sites: GDPR and CCPA pages, kept current
  • SaaS and membership sites: terms, EULA, and age verification for gated content

🍪 Pair it with WPLP Cookie Consent

A privacy policy describes the cookies on your site. A cookie banner gets consent for them. WPLP Cookie Consent is the free cookie banner from the same team: cookie scanning, script blocking, consent logs, and Google Consent Mode v2.

🔌 Compatibility

  • Editors and page builders: Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi
  • Ecommerce and forms: WooCommerce, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms
  • Translation: WPML
  • WordPress Multisite: works on Multisite networks
  • Template languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese

  • Guides

plugins.description:
Trusted by 30,000+ WordPress sites · IAB Europe TCF v2.3 Registered · Google Certified CMP Partner · Setup in under 5 minutes, no coding required · No traffic caps or visitor-based pricing.

WPLP Cookie Consent is a free WordPress cookie consent plugin that adds a customizable cookie banner, blocks third-party scripts until visitors consent, and keeps your cookie disclosures accurate with a built-in cookie scanner. Help meet GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, ePrivacy, UK GDPR, LGPD, POPIA, PIPEDA and other global privacy law requirements – with consent records stored on your own site, not a third-party dashboard.

WPLP Cookie Consent is the core consent management module of the WPLP Compliance Platform, the same platform that also powers WPLP’s legal policy generators. Cookie consent and legal documentation are built on one connected system, so your cookie banner, cookie scan results, and cookie policy page all stay in sync instead of living in separate, disconnected tools.

The plugin is built to be easy to configure out of the box, while still giving you the depth of controls needed to understand exactly what cookies your site uses and manage consent for each one.

✅ Why Choose WPLP Cookie Consent

  • Built-in cookie scanner – automatically detects cookies and third-party scripts running on your site, no manual auditing required

  • Automatic script & content blocking – stops Google Analytics, Meta/Facebook Pixel, Google Ads, Microsoft Clarity, TikTok Pixel, LinkedIn Insight Tag, and social embeds from loading until a visitor consents

  • Google Consent Mode v2 – keep Google Ads and Analytics working correctly while respecting visitor consent signals

  • Consent logging – stores consent status, category, and timestamp for audit-ready records, kept on your own WordPress database

  • Drag & drop banner builder – match your brand with custom colors, layouts, fonts, and button text, no CSS required

  • Free tier includes real compliance tools – cookie scanning and script blocking aren’t locked behind a paywall

  • WP Consent API support – shares visitor consent state with compatible WordPress plugins

⚖️ Why Choose WPLP Cookie Consent Over a SaaS CMP

Most cookie consent platforms are hosted SaaS tools that charge by pageviews or monthly visitors and keep your consent records on their servers. WPLP Cookie Consent works differently: it runs entirely inside WordPress, stores every consent record in your own database, and never caps how much traffic your site gets.

You get real compliance tooling – cookie scanning, script blocking, and consent logging in the free plugin, with no per-visitor pricing and no third-party dashboard to depend on.

📄 Features

Customizable Cookie Consent Banner

Configure a cookie banner that matches your site’s design and your specific consent requirements:

  • Multiple banner layouts and positions (bar, box, popup)

  • Customizable text, colors, and button labels to match your branding

  • Category-based consent for analytics, marketing, and functional cookies

  • Optional explicit Accept or Reject actions for visitors

  • A preference center that lets visitors reopen the banner and change their choices by category at any time

  • Per-service consent toggles that let visitors approve or block individual tracking services, not just categories

  • Accessibility-friendly banner designed to follow WCAG / ADA guidelines

  • CCPA / CPRA “Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information” opt-out link for California visitors

Cookie Scanning and Detection

A built-in cookie scanner automatically detects cookies and third-party services running on your website, so your disclosures stay accurate as your site evolves. The scanner helps you:

  • Identify cookies and scripts added by commonly used services and plugins

  • Group detected cookies by category for clearer visitor-facing disclosure

  • Keep cookie information up to date as your site changes over time

  • Scan results feed directly into your cookie policy and consent configuration, so what you disclose always reflects what’s actually running on your site.

Automatic Script and Content Blocking

The plugin prevents non-essential third-party scripts from loading until a visitor gives consent, covering:

  • Analytics tools like Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager

  • Advertising and marketing scripts, including Meta (Facebook) Pixel and TikTok Pixel

  • Embedded media and social content such as YouTube, Vimeo, Google Maps, and social embeds

Script blocking works whether scripts are added directly, through another plugin, or via a tag manager. Google Consent Mode v2 is supported out of the box, so Google services can adjust their behavior automatically based on visitor consent signals.

⭐ Premium Features

Unlock advanced consent management by upgrading to a WPLP premium plan:

  • Geo-targeted banners – show region-specific consent banners for the EU, US/California, Canada, Brazil, and other regions

  • IAB TCF v2.3 framework – full Transparency & Consent Framework support for publishers and programmatic advertising

  • Google Consent Mode v2 advanced integration and Additional Consent support

  • Additional banner languages and auto-translation for multilingual sites

  • A/B testing to compare banner designs and improve consent rates

  • Priority premium support

🆓 Free vs Premium

Everything you need to run compliant cookie consent is in the free plugin, there is no locked-down “lite” experience.

Free plugin includes: customizable cookie banner, built-in cookie scanner, automatic script and content blocking, category-based consent, preference center, consent logging stored in your own database, Google Consent Mode v2, WP Consent API support, and multilingual compatibility.

Premium adds: geo-targeted regional banners, IAB TCF v2.3 framework, A/B testing for banners, and priority support.

🛡️ Supported Privacy Laws & Regulations

WPLP Cookie Consent helps you build a cookie consent workflow aligned with major privacy laws around the world, including:

  • General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) – European Union

  • California Consumer Privacy Act / CPRA (CCPA) – California, USA

  • UK GDPR – United Kingdom

  • ePrivacy Directive (ePD) – European Union

  • Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD) – Brazil

  • Virginia Consumer Data Protection Act (VCDPA) – Virginia, and more…

Laws and requirements vary by jurisdiction and change over time. Consult a legal professional to confirm what applies to your website.

👥 Who Uses WPLP Cookie Consent

  • Bloggers & publishers: running Google Analytics, AdSense, or affiliate tracking

  • WooCommerce & eCommerce stores: needing cookie compliance alongside checkout and ad tracking

  • Membership & online course sites: managing logged-in user consent alongside marketing cookies

  • Agencies & developers: managing consistent cookie consent setups across multiple client sites

  • News & media sites: with heavy embedded content and third-party ad networks

  • Multilingual & global sites: needing region-specific banners and translated consent text

⚙️ Setup and Compatibility

  • Guided setup wizard for fast configuration

  • Works with popular themes and page builders (Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg)

  • Compatible with WooCommerce, Easy Digital Downloads, Google Tag Manager

  • Works alongside common form plugins (WPForms, Gravity Forms, Contact Form 7)

  • Translation-ready and compatible with popular multilingual plugins (WPML, Polylang)

📚 Documentation & Support

Need help getting started? Our documentation covers everything from setup to troubleshooting.

  • Overview: Learn about the WPLP Compliance Platform and its core features.

  • Compliance Setup Wizard: Follow our step-by-step guide to configure your website for privacy compliance.

  • Guides: Explore detailed guides and tutorials to make the most of the plugin’s features.

  • FAQs: Find answers to frequently asked questions and troubleshooting tips.

For questions related to features or compatibility, you can contact the WPLP Legal Pages support team.
